# sustain_on_call_schedule (Resource)

Some of the workspace's people, on call in turn by the clock in its time zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A week each, in turn, by London's clocks, from Monday 2 November.
resource "sustain_on_call_schedule" "ops" {
  name         = "Ops"
  time_zone    = "Europe/London"
  first_shift  = "2026-11-02T09:00"
  shift_length = 1
  shift_unit   = "week"
  user_ids     = ["44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `first_shift` (String) When the first shift starts, in its time zone, such as 2026-10-12T09:00.
- `name` (String)
- `shift_length` (Number) How many of `shift_unit` a shift lasts.
- `shift_unit` (String)
- `time_zone` (String) An IANA time zone, such as Europe/London.
- `user_ids` (List of String) The rota: the workspace's people, by their ids, in turn.

### Optional

- `fallback_user_ids` (List of String) The people it alerts when nobody's on call, with people: none otherwise.
- `on_duty` (Attributes) When an on-call schedule is on: the days its hours start, from one time of day until another, in its time zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--on_duty))
- `when_nobody` (String) Whom it alerts when nobody's on call: wait, holding an alert while it is off until it is on again; contacts, every confirmed contact; or people, those it names. With nobody left on its rota, wait alerts every contact.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--on_duty"></a>
### Nested Schema for `on_duty`

Required:

- `days` (List of String)
- `from` (String) When it's on from, each day, as HH:MM.
- `until` (String) When it's on until, each day, as HH:MM.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_on_call_schedule.ops <id>
```
